extracted.name: Easy, Tasty Beets
extracted.description: Shredded beets are simmered until tender, flavored with a little butter, seasonings, and balsamic vinegar.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Shred beets in a food processor fitted with the shredding blade.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add shredded beets; cook and stir until slightly softened, about 5 minutes.
Add water to skillet; cover. Simmer until beets completely softened, about 10 minutes. Stir in balsamic vinegar; season with salt and pepper.
